text:
elaine_cs: Quick alert 12: BrightBay renewal is stalled. They want SAML SSO proof for procurement before they will sign the SOW and attach the PO. Quote here: https://docsend.com/s/brightbay-renewal. Also billing entity on their PO doesn't match our invoice. Can we triage?

omar_ae: i spoke with buyer. procurement insists on (1) signed SOW, (2) PO referencing the same legal entity, (3) SAML metadata or screenshot showing SSO in staging. they are refusing to accept a temp vendor code.

frank_fin: noted. without vendor code we can't process the PO in our AP system. if they refuse temp codes we need full vendor creation: reg doc + VAT/GST (if EU). did they provide reg number?

elaine_cs: they provided a VAT number but said legal name is "BrightBay Technologies UK" on PO and our invoices show "BrightBay Ltd". buyer says they can't change their PO format.

rachel_legal: legal note 12: we can accept a trading-as annotation on the SOW to match PO: add line "Seller acknowledges invoices may reference trading name BrightBay Technologies UK" and keep invoice legal name as BrightBay Ltd. i'll prepare a one-line addendum.

tim_se: i can produce a short SSO proof: screenshot of successful SAML test in staging and the metadata XML. which format do they accept?

omar_ae: procurement asked specifically for either a signed vendor SSO acceptance form or a screenshot showing test user login plus metadata URL. screenshot preferred.

vendor_bot: Vendor lookup for "BrightBay Technologies UK" returned one close match: "BrightBay Ltd" but names differ. Recommend vendor creation request with attached proof (reg + VAT).

frank_fin: frank_fin here: if we get reg + VAT we'll create vendor ENT-BB-704. until then we can attempt to accept the PO as a supporting document to expedite onboarding, but finance needs the legal name to match or the trading-as clause.

elaine_cs: i'll send the trading-as addendum and ask Tim to attach the SAML screenshot. cc: procurement contact emma@brightbay.co.uk and AP econ@brightbay.co.uk. trying to get signature today.

tim_se: screenshot + metadata uploaded to DocuSign envelope notes. preparing DocuSign envelope now.

omar_ae: please route to CEO (signing authority) and AP. i've asked them to confirm by EOD.

rachel_legal: addendum language (paste verbatim): "Seller acknowledges that Buyer may reference the trading name 'BrightBay Technologies UK' on purchase orders; invoices shall be issued to Seller's legal entity name 'BrightBay Ltd.' Buyer confirms that such reference does not alter Seller's legal obligations under this Agreement." use that exact text.

tim_se: DocuSign created: https://docusign.com/envelope/bb-2026-ssoproof routed to CEO then AP. included trading-as addendum and SAML screenshot in envelope comments. envelope expiry 7 days.

elaine_cs: procurement viewed envelope at 1785553000 and replied asking whether finance can accept the PO now to queue invoice, pending vendor creation.

frank_fin: we can accept the PO as a supporting attachment to create a provisional invoice, but we will not finalize vendor until reg docs verified. We'll assign temp processing flag `PROV-INV` so AP can move.

omar_ae: customer just replied attaching PO and confirming VAT number at 1785553600. they said CEO will sign within 24hrs.

rachel_legal: good. once signed i'll countersign. quick reminder: ensure the DocuSign envelope contains the exact addendum text.

tim_se: CEO signed at 1785554200, AP attached PO.

frank_fin: received PO and reg docs. creating vendor ENT-BB-704 at 1785554600. will move invoice to processing queue and reconcile trading-as note.

elaine_cs: status: SOW addendum signed, SAML proof provided, PO attached, vendor created. closing once finance confirms invoice issued. great hustle. :tada:
